source: Open web (Adams Consulting Engineers careers page)
title: Graduate program expression of interest (civil engineering, Melbourne or Geelong)
content_text: Careers page, read 6 Oct 2026: 'Are you a Recent Graduate? Join our team at Adams and kick-start your career as a graduate in structural and civil engineering! Our graduate program provides a pathway to ongoing employment while immersing you in the captivating world of engineering. With guidance from our team of highly skilled and experienced engineers, you'll gain hands-on experience in concept design, construction stages, and more.' 'Interested in joining our team? Register your interest. Whether you are seeking a fresh start, or just beginning your career, we would love to hear from you. If you don't see any open positions that match your skills, feel free to forward your resume to us.' No open positions were listed on the page when read. Offices: Melbourne (Level 10, 620 Bourke Street), Geelong (Newtown), Sydney, Ballarat Collective, Brisbane.
apply_instructions: Register your interest on https://adamseng.com.au/career/#apply_now (careers form). Contact page lists admin@adamseng.com.au as the office inbox, but the careers page does not name it as the application address, so it is not used for email.
